title: Login and access protected order history
description: Verifies a user can log in with valid credentials and view order history on the protected Orders page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to view order history
Verify order history content is displayed

title: Invalid login shows authentication error and does not authenticate
description: Verifies invalid credentials show an authentication error and the user remains unauthenticated.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill invalid@example.com into the email field
Fill wrongpassword into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page

title: Logout returns user to unauthenticated state
description: Verifies a logged-in user can log out and is returned to an unauthenticated experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click Logout
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Protected Orders route requires authentication
description: Verifies unauthenticated users cannot access Orders and are redirected to login.

steps.description: Navigate to /orders
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Protected Admin route requires authentication
description: Verifies unauthenticated users cannot access Admin and are redirected to login.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Login enables access to Admin page
description: Verifies a user can log in and then access the protected Admin page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the admin page
Verify the admin product management content is displayed

title: Catalog page loads and displays product cards
description: Verifies the product catalog loads and displays product cards with metadata.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify product cards are displayed

title: Open product details from catalog
description: Verifies a user can navigate from the catalog to a product details page and see primary product information.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the view-details action on a product card
Verify product image, category, price, and description are displayed

title: Unauthenticated purchase initiation is prevented from catalog
description: Verifies the catalog buy action is not available to unauthenticated users.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the buy action is disabled or a login-required prompt is shown when attempting to purchase

title: Authenticated user can buy from catalog and see success feedback
description: Verifies an authenticated user can initiate a purchase from the catalog and receives immediate success feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the product catalog
Click the buy action on a product card
Verify a purchase success confirmation is visible

title: Authenticated purchase from product details shows success and appears in order history
description: Verifies an authenticated user can purchase from product details, see success feedback, and then see the order in order history.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the product catalog
Click the view-details action on a product card
Click the buy action on the product details page
Click the link to view order history
Verify the newly created order entry for the purchased product is displayed

title: Unauthenticated purchase is prevented from product details
description: Verifies unauthenticated users cannot complete a purchase from product details and see a login-required or prevented state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the view-details action on a product card
Click the buy action on the product details page
Verify a login-required message is visible or the purchase is prevented

title: Product details page displays primary product information
description: Verifies the product details page shows image, category, price, and description for a product opened from the catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the view-details action on a product card
Verify product image, category, price, and description are displayed

title: Order history displays order cards for an authenticated user
description: Verifies that a logged-in user can reach the Orders page and see order entries with key fields.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /orders
Verify order cards are displayed
Verify each visible order card shows a product, a price, and a date

title: Unauthenticated access to Orders redirects to login
description: Verifies that the Orders page is protected and unauthenticated users are redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /orders
Verify the user lands on the login page
Verify a login form is displayed

title: Admin page loads for authenticated user
description: Verifies that a logged-in user can access the Admin page and see product management UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Verify the admin product management form is displayed
Verify a list of existing products is displayed

title: Admin can add a new product and see it in the list with success feedback
description: Verifies creating a product via the admin form updates the admin list and shows a success notification.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Fill Test Product A into the product name field
Fill a valid price into the price field
Fill a valid image URL into the image URL field
Submit the product form to add the product
Verify the product list contains Test Product A
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Admin can edit an existing product and see updated values with success feedback
description: Verifies editing an existing product updates the list and shows a success notification.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Select an existing product from the admin list to edit
Fill Edited Product Name into the product name field
Save the product changes
Verify the product list contains Edited Product Name
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Admin can delete an existing product and see it removed with success feedback
description: Verifies deleting a product removes it from the admin list and shows a success notification.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Fill Delete Me Product into the product name field
Fill a valid price into the price field
Fill a valid image URL into the image URL field
Submit the product form to add the product
Delete the product named Delete Me Product
Verify the product list does not contain Delete Me Product
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Unauthenticated access to Admin redirects to login
description: Verifies that the Admin page is protected and unauthenticated users are redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the user lands on the login page
Verify a login form is displayed

title: Admin product changes are lost after refresh due to in-memory state reset
description: Verifies that admin CRUD changes do not persist after a page refresh and the added product disappears.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Fill Temp Product To Reset into the product name field
Fill a valid price into the price field
Fill a valid image URL into the image URL field
Submit the product form to add the product
Refresh the page
Verify the product list does not contain Temp Product To Reset
Verify a list of existing products is displayed
